730 is a low-end GPU. The nvidia naming scheme goes as follows:

  • The first digit is the series
  • The other two digits are the "class", where 00-30 = low-end, 40-60 = mid-range, 70-90 = high-end
  • "Ti" at the end usually indicates a revised or upgraded version in the same category, e.g. 750 Ti is a completely different architecture compared to the 750, but it also aims at the same kind of consumers.

Also, what kind of processor is it? What kind of RAM? Just the clockrate on the processor doesn't tell us much. The exact model is important.
